dashboard.settings.autoAcceptHelp: Orders are confirmed automatically. If the requested slot is full, the order moves to the next available slot. It only confirms when there is capacity. Orders with customer notes (e.g. an allergy) will still need to be confirmed.
dashboard.settings.layoutHelp: How items are shown on the “Add order” screen.
dashboard.settings.layoutTabsHelp: Shows one category at a time. Tap a category to switch to it. Ideal for long menus, where each item always stays in the same place.
dashboard.settings.layoutScrollHelp: Shows all items in a single scrolling list, with a heading for each category. There are no category buttons: you scroll to move around. Ideal for short menus, where you can see almost all of it at once.
dashboard.settings.paidStepHelp: Adds a “Confirm” button when you add an order yourself, so you can record it now and take payment later.
dashboard.settings.takesCashHelp: Splits the payment button into “Cash” and “Card”.
dashboard.settings.orderReadyHelp: Shows a “Mark as ready” button on the orders screen. Kitchen screens are set up separately. Customers get an email each time an order is marked as ready.
dashboard.settings.buzzerPromptTitle: Remind me to add a buzzer
dashboard.settings.buzzerPromptHelp: Opens the buzzer grid as soon as you place an order, so the number appears on the board while the customer is still in front of you. If you turn it off, you can still add a buzzer whenever you like by tapping the order, but nothing will remind you. Useful if you hand out buzzers; easy to turn off if you don’t.
dashboard.settings.cardsHelp: Turn this off if there is a problem with cards and customers will place orders as usual but pay at the food truck. Orders keep arriving; only the card step stops.
dashboard.settings.cardsScope: This applies to your whole food truck, on all events, and stays off until you turn it back on.
dashboard.settings.soundsHelp: The on/off switch is on each screen; each device controls its own sound.
